notes.title: Lost Arsenal Patch 1.2.1
notes.notes:
This is a minor update focused on bug fixes for Lost Arsenal. We hope you are enjoying the new content! We are still working on a few other issues, including an Undo issue related to Echo Vault, but wanted to get this update out before the weekend.



Here is the full list of changes:
[olist]
Fixed an issue with Echo Vault incorrectly recasting X Cost spells with zero ember.

Disallowed Infusion spells being recast by Echo Vault. Infusion cards are not meant to be copy-able for any reason.

Fixed bug where text on Fel's Unchained path would sometimes be incorrect.

Fixed a few room and equipment cards not appearing in proper card pools for shops and units.

notes.title: Lost Arsenal Free Content Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
Lost Arsenal is now live! Monster Train 2’s first free update offers plenty of new opportunities to hone your strategy and approach each run in new and exciting ways! In this update, you’ll find…

New Cards for Every Clan

Every Monster Train 2 clan now has unique, powerful new cards to add to your arsenal and transform your run strategy. Whether you’re looking to scale your damage with Glutton’s Maw or reach new magical potential with Echo Vault, these new cards will open up a world of possibilities.


New Clanless Equipment and Room Cards


Strategize with a range of new room and equipment cards that bring additional layers of depth to your runs. Give the start of your turn an edge with cards such as Weapons Cache, which draws Equipment Cards and reduces its cost each time you spawn a new allied unit. This is just one of the many new cards to explore. See the full list with screenshots below!


A Newly Balanced and Tuned Game


Want the full breakdown of everything that’s been added and changed? You can now view the complete balance notes for Lost Arsenal in a two part series on Steam. The first part, which details major reworks to existing cards, and the second offers a complete list of balance changes made to Monster Train 2. The list below details every balance change and bug fix in one place for your convenience.



Lost Arsenal brings a fresh wave of strategic depth to Monster Train 2, so pick your champion, optimize your deck and prepare for the ultimate run! We can’t wait to see how you adapt your strategies to the latest additions in Lost Arsenal and what new synergies you’ll discover. Let us know your thoughts on the update either in the comments or in the Shiny Shoe Discord server and be sure to share your most creative builds for everyone to enjoy! Want more Monster Train 2 content? Subscribe to the Shiny Shoe newsletter for behind-the-scenes tidbits! And, finally, don't forget to join us for a special dev stream on Twitch at 12:00 PM PDT today, September 10th! 



Thank you for supporting our team by playing Monster Train 2: Lost Arsenal!

notes.title: Lost Arsenal Preview 4: All the Balance Changes to Monster Train 2, Part 2
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! 



This is the second part in a two-part series about all the balance changes coming to Monster Train 2! If you have not read the first part and would like to do so, you can find the post here! 



Now, onto the rest of the balance changes! But first, please know that the following text does contain some spoilers for Monster Train 2 so only keep reading if you are alright with that. 


Challenges 
Reworking existing and beloved cards can pose the risk of turning what was once an interesting card to one that is worse or less fun. We ran into this, for example, in the case of Hallowed Halls.  We experimented with making it into a Room Card, instead of killing units and reforming them to fill your room when you used it, it would do the same effect automatically at the end of each combat. Testers found that it simply wasn’t as fun to play. Ultimately that change never made it through. 

However we decided to update a card, we had to be cognizant of not straying too far from the card’s original identity. Consumer of Crowns, for example, need to have something to do with imps, if not just to match with the pre-existing theme and lore for the card, but also to continue to prop up Imp builds. With certain cards that didn’t have a strong identity, such as Husk Hermit or Lady of the House, we felt more freedom to give them a unique identity.

Another challenge we ran into was with addressing infinites. There are plenty of infinites that exist that we’re aware of, and there’s probably way more that we aren’t aware of. There is even a wiki page for infinites that players have found. When they’re too easy to achieve, infinites can trivialize the game and completely remove the tension of a run. 

But, sometimes stumbling into an infinite can be fun, especially ones that require a really specific combination of cards that you’re unlikely to run into again. And other times, the solution to removing an infinite can lead to something less fun in the majority of use cases, in exchange for fixing a really small set of interactions. Fixing infinites can be a bit of a game of whack-a-mole, so our approach is to try to address the most egregious and reliable infinites, while taking less of a hard-line stance on the more niche or esoteric ones.

For example with Deep Offering, one of the ways to achieve an infinite is to upgrade it with Eternalstone and Smolderstone, and duplicate it, which could be achieved quite reliably in a run. To address it, we tried adding “This card’s Consume cannot be removed.” However we quickly realized that an effect that essentially negated a spell upgrade felt too restrictive, and a bit antithetical to Monster Train’s ethos. So instead we increased its cost, making this specific combo of upgrades no longer infinite. But, It’s still entirely possible to achieve an infinite with Deep Offering, you could simply use Entropic Energy instead of Smolderstone, but it would be a bit more difficult to reliably pull off.

We also wanted to add a fresh coat of paint to some cards like Husk Hermit (which was kind of a less interesting version of Shattered Shell). In conjunction with card updates, we also wanted to address some of the weaker cards and clans that didn’t get enough love in the first balance update. Some of the reworks to cards were simultaneously buffs, such as the update to Cuttlehex or Animus of Speed. And finally we also wanted to address some long-standing infinites that we felt were too easy and reliable to achieve.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, today we have launched an update to Monster Train 2 with a variety of bug fixes, balance changes, UI fixes/features, and translation improvements. Check out the list below for full details.



Thank you for playing Monster Train 2! We've got more updates to come as we work to make MT2 the best game it can be.



We are going to start numbering the patches from now on. This is patch 1.1.2.


Bug Fixes

[olist]
Fixed a softlock when the ‘Twisting Mycelium’ artifact is present under rare circumstances.

Fixed a softlock caused by combinations of Reanimate, Burnout, and Harvest under certain conditions.

Fixed a Cluster Colonel spawned Funguy making the front friendly character unplayable under rare conditions.

Fixed Mooncaller unit's Mooncycle trigger bonus not applying to the 'Fae's Nook' artifact.

Fixed Fhyra's Greed Pyre Heart not granting money when taking pyre damage from Celestial Alcove events.

Fixed bug where Trample would not work in a room with Imprisoned Zephyr.

Fixed bug where Titan damage and status popups would not appear in the correct location.

Fixed the option to abandon a Relentless battle going on for many rounds not actually abandoning the battle.

Fixed visual issues with TFB background.

Fixed a sorting issue with Chosen VFX.

Fixed Astreal the Lost having incorrect Titan affinity VFX.

Fixed Mooncaller feet, reanimate visuals, and relentless debris not being clipped by the floor properly.

Fixed Savage Spirit upgrade not granting the correct amount of attack.

Fixed bug where restarting a battle in the middle of playing Soldier of Fortune or similar unit-drawing cards could leave a card stuck on-screen.

Fixed Trample damage not triggering Avarice.

Fixed bug where Sacrificial Chamber would not trigger for bosses.

Fixed 'Penitent's Bloodsuit' on a Monster not triggering 'Taskmaster's Lash' when the character shifts.

Fixed bug where Canio, Yorrick, Kwilling Catcher, and Avarice were not impacted by the Tithe or Moneybag mutators.

Fixed Corruption status effect being unaffected by Propagate effects.

Fixed 'Spotted Spore' artifact only granting one bonus per spell cast instead of one bonus per Troop stack added.

Fixed the 'Split Anvil' artifact incorrectly leaving a cost bonus on spell copies sent directly to the discard pile (ex: Spreading Spores, Contagious).

Fixed 'Mushy Room' card text not showing bonus effects of the Duality Mutator.

Fixed bug where Silence from enchantments would not properly suppress Spawn triggers.

Fixed Inhale not spawning a Funguy when it slays a Monster unit in a room at max character limit.

Fixed missing Ephemeral tooltip for Ekka's Lunar Echo ability.

Fixed various typos in English.
[/olist]

Balance Changes

[olist]
Spellchain and Holystone can now be upgraded together on the same card.

Funguy that Ascend/Descend will no longer trigger Rally when they merge with another Funguy.

Tidal Turning base healing reduced from 20 >>> 10.

Morel Mistress attack increased from 5 >>> 15.

Miser stats updated from 3/9 >>> 8/8.

Lunar Priestess stats increased from 5/5 >>> 8/8.

Silent Sentinel attack increased from 0 >>> 10.

Pincushion stats increased from 6/6 >>> 12/12.
[/olist]

UI Changes

[olist]
Added a button to the Mix selection screen to hide the draft options so players can see the state of the battle before making their choice.

Celestial Alcove events with 2 rewards now display tooltips and are stacked instead of side by side.

Moved Calcified Ember notification to the bottom of the cards in the draft screen and added a glow around it to draw more attention to it.

In the Battle Intro screen, fixed the enemy on the pedestal sometimes only having a small hover area for tooltips in battle intro screen.

The Dragon’s Hoard “Loot” button sheen is now disabled when you have zero Dragon's Hoard.

Updated Battle Name, Waves Remaining and Community Challenges Name layout to fix bug with some overlapping elements.

Upgrade names should no longer overlap custom challenge names in the Light Forge screen.

In the Run Opening screen, adjust the OK button to render below any tooltips from cards that might overlap it.

Fixed some tooltips for Covenant buffs not showing up in battle preview.

Updated layout of Trials so that the Trial description text and Trials toggle button do not overlap in some languages.

New unlocks are now immediately notified after leaving story dialogues.

Fixed preventing clan and pyre heart selection dialogs from closing when clicking inside them, but not on the clan or pyre heart items.

Fixed minor positioning issue with the champion upgrade screen card frames.

Boss starter status effect and matching Covenant status effect stack counts are now combined when showing tooltips outside of combat.

Merchant voice over now occurs half as often.

Made minor layout adjustment to dimensional challenges layout to center content a little better.
[/olist]

Localization Changes

[olist]
Fixed numerous bugs in the Korean translation.

Fixed numerous bugs in the Russian translation.

Fixed a few issues in the Simplified Chinese translation.

Fixed wrong Japanese kanji used in Dimensional Challenge lock message.
[/olist]


Thank you to everyone who has contributed suggestions to improve translations.


Bug Fixes - Spoilers

notes.title: Patch Notes May 28
notes.notes:
Today we are releasing our third bug fix and tuning update for Monster Train 2 after launch. We didn't make Steam posts for the prior updates so I will merge all notes from all patches into this post. In the future, we will do a post each time.

We are working on more bug fixes, quality of life improvements, and non-English translation improvements. Those will be releasing soon.

Changes:

[olist]
 Seraph Aeternus - The Dominant: No longer continues to apply his action trigger during Relentless.
 Room cards should now show the proper mastery frame in the Logbook.
 Fixed being able to spam click Pyre Heart ability activation.
 Fixed a softlock under certain conditions when the 'Curse of Friendly Fire' mutator is present.
 Fixed duplicate endless artifacts removed when restarting battle in Endless mode.
 Fixed some softlocks and other bugs with secret content. See the mt2-spoilers-chat channel in Discord for more information.
 Made some small stat changes to Pyre Hearts that were notably performing outside of a median range. Very slightly decreased health on Pyre of Dominion, Malicka's Shifting Pyre, and Heart of the Pact. Very slightly increased health on Bogwurm's Growth.
 Fixed the fact that only Shield Steward damage was counting toward unlock progress.
 Herzal's Horde unlock condition increased from 8000 >>> 10000.
 Fixed some typos and missing tooltips.
 Heart of the Pact unlock condition reduced from 9 >>> 7.
 Buffed stats of various units and cards that I won't mention due to spoilers.,
 Fixed Battle 7 "Savagery's Final Assault" battle showing incorrect enemy in battle preview screen.
 Fixed Fel champ Savior ability causing a softlock under certain rare conditions.
 Fixed 'Mitosis Cap' created unit duplicates not receiving the Ascetic Absolution upgrade from the Penance Fields story event.
 Changed Enfeebling Infusion's default target on keyboard/controller to target the enemy team.
 Fixed part of the map victory animation that was broken.
 Fixed Gravity mutator triggering during the deployment phase.
 Hid certain run configuration options that could be problematic if used before enough content was unlocked.
 Fixed French translation of Prismatic Dragonscale. It said it triggered at the start of battle but it's actually the end.
 Improved Japanese translation of Artificer trigger description.
 The Undying One "Resolve: Gain Reanimate 6" trigger moved from Covenant 0 to Covenant 4.
 Luna Coven unlock condition decreased from 70 >>> 40.
 Underlegion unlock condition decreased from 120 >>> 75.
 Aquath's Reservation unlock condition decreased from 15000 >>> 12000.
 Wyngh's Spirit unlock condition reduced from 275 >>> 225.
 Echo of the Time Father unlock condition reduced from 40 >>> 25.
 Fixed softlock that could sometimes happen when pushback Arkion killed a unit.
[/olist]
